responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exposes the minimal debug-tree helper implemented by m2misc.cc. Its role is to make GCC tree inspection callable from Modula-2-side debugging code, not to participate in normal compilation semantics.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition module for the m2misc group: it exports just the DebugTree entry point to Modula-2 code, unlike m2misc.h and m2misc.cc, which also cover native helpers for tree chains and current statement-list dumping.
